property_summary: After any sequence of operations ending with Collect(uint256), MinSum must remain unchanged from its initial value (set during setup).
After any call to Collect(uint256), MinSum must equal the value last assigned by a successful call to SetMinSum(uint256) (i.e., it cannot have been set to 0 by a revert).
MinSum must not decrease below its value set by SetMinSum, unless SetMinSum is called again with a smaller value.

After any call to Collect(uint256) that doesn't revert, the value of MinSum must equal the last value passed to a successful SetMinSum call (i.e., MinSum must not become 0 due to a revert in SetMinSum).
After any call to Collect(uint256), MinSum must equal the value set by the last successful SetMinSum call, even if the Collect call reverts.
For any caller and amount, calling Collect does not change MinSum.
The value of MinSum remains unchanged after any sequence of calls ending with Collect.
After any call to Collect, the value of MinSum equals the initial value set by SetMinSum before initialization.
After any sequence of operations ending with a Collect call, the state variable MinSum is equal to the initial MinSum set before Initialized.
After Initialized() is called, SetLogFile() always returns the address set in SetLogFile(), not MinSum.
After Initialized() and any number of Put/Collect calls, the address returned by SetLogFile() is never zero.
After Initialized() is called, LogFile always equals the address set in SetLogFile(), not MinSum.
After Initialized() is called and a Collect completes, the stored address of the LogFile contract is not equal to the MinSum value.
After calling Collect, the SetLogFile address remains unchanged (equal to the initially set value) for any inputs that avoid reverts.
After any call to Collect, the second call to SetLogFile returns the same address as the first call.
After calling Collect, the stored LogFile address equals the address previously set by SetLogFile, regardless of the function's revert behavior.
The SetLogFile address is never changed after Initialized() is called, regardless of any subsequent calls to Collect().
After Initialized() is called, the LogFile address stored in C remains unchanged by any subsequent call to Collect, regardless of inputs.
After a Collect call that succeeds, the unlockTime of the caller is never updated (remains unchanged) if it was already greater than or equal to block.timestamp + _lockTime.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's unlockTime is never decreased relative to its value before the call.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's unlockTime is never changed if it was already greater than or equal to block.timestamp + _lockTime.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's unlockTime never increases relative to the value that would have been set by the most recent Put call.
After a Collect call, the caller's unlockTime is never decreased relative to its value before the call.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the balance of an account never underflows (i.e., acc.balance before subtraction is at least the amount subtracted).
After a call to Collect, the balance of any account that meets the conditions should decrease exactly by the requested amount, and the balance should always be non-negative.

After any call to Collect, the balance of msg.sender before the call can be expressed as a sum of the amounts put in minus the amounts collected, and the balance after the call must be consistent with that accounting.
After any call to Collect, the total balance of the contract (address(c).balance) equals the sum of all account balances recorded in the Acc mapping for all addresses.

After any call to Collect(uint256), the balance of the caller (msg.sender) in the Acc mapping is never greater than the contract's total balance minus the sum of all other accounts' balances, ensuring no integer overflow leads to inconsistent state.
After Collect is called, the sum of all balances (acc.balance for each address) plus the contract balance remains equal to the total ether ever sent via Put, regardless of inputs.
After Collect is called, the caller's balance in the contract never exceeds the caller's previous balance before Collect.
After Collect is called, the caller's Acc.balance is always less than or equal to its value before the call.

After Collect is called with any arguments, the balance of the caller in the contract is never greater than the unlock time minus the current block timestamp (i.e., the balance is zero if unlocked, or the balance is unchanged if locked).
The total ether in the contract (sum of all account balances stored in the mapping plus the contract's own balance) is unchanged by any call to Collect.
The total balance of the contract plus all account balances equals the total ether sent to the contract.
The balance of any account is non-negative at any time.
After a Collect call, all account balances in the mapping acc are non-decreasing over consecutive Collect calls.
The balance of any account after a Put call is greater than or equal to its balance before the Put call.
After a Collect call, the total ether in the contract (address(c).balance) is less than or equal to its previous value before the call.
After a Collect call, the unlockTime of the caller is always greater than or equal to block.timestamp at the time of the previous Put call plus the lockTime argument.
After Collect, the unlockTime of the caller is always equal to the timestamp of the most recent Put call plus its lockTime argument.
The unlockTime of the caller after Collect is the maximum of the previous unlockTime and block.timestamp + _lockTime.
After a Collect call, the unlockTime of the caller is always exactly the sum of block.timestamp and _lockTime from the most recent Put call, regardless of previous unlockTime
After a Collect call that succeeds, the caller's unlockTime is always equal to the maximum of its previous unlockTime and block.timestamp + _lockTime from the most recent Put.
After calling Collect, the balance of the contract plus the balances of all accounts is unchanged (conservation of ether).
Collect shall not succeed before the unlock time has passed; after calling Put with a lock time, Collect should not be able to reduce the sender's balance before that time expires.
After a call to Put with a positive lock time, subsequent calls to Collect with a positive amount should not succeed unless block.timestamp has passed the current unlock time.
After calling Put with a non-zero lockTime, the unlockTime for the caller must be at least block.timestamp + lockTime.
After calling Put, the unlockTime for the caller must be at least block.timestamp + lockTime.
Collect never increases the caller's balance in the contract.
After Collect, the caller's recorded balance change (old balance - new balance) equals the amount withdrawn.
Collect decreases the caller's recorded balance by exactly the withdrawn amount when successful.
After a successful Collect call, the sum of caller's recorded balance and contract's ETH balance is non-decreasing relative to before the call.
A successful Collect call never increases the caller's recorded balance in the contract.
